title: Among the schools with the average score in Math over 560 in the SAT test,
question: Among the schools with the average score in Math over 560 in the SAT test, how many schools are directly charter-funded?

prediction.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools c ON s.XCL_030 = c.XCL_041
WHERE s.XCL_038 > 560
  AND c.XCL_065 = 'Directly funded';
